repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
triggered := false
if (triggered == true) {
wait until(not (all(#ContactSensor).contactSensor_contact == false))
triggered = false
}
wait until(all(#ContactSensor).contactSensor_contact == false)
all(#Switch).switch_on()
triggered = true

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a rising-edge wait on `ContactSensor.Contact == false` (firing when it transitions from true to false). The candidate uses `wait until(not (... == false))` which waits for the condition to become true (contact == true), effectively waiting for a falling edge or a held-true state, causing the mismatch at t=0 where the sensor is already false.
diagnosis.change_summary: Replaced the incorrect rising-edge wait for `false` with the correct rising-edge wait for `false` using the standard two-wait rearm pattern. The condition `all(#ContactSensor).contactSensor_contact == false` is now waited for directly, ensuring the action fires immediately when the condition becomes true (rising edge of 'false').
